_meta.description: Verified English-Yoruba terminology. Every mapping is attested (FLORES renderings or established usage); nothing invented. Entries with a 'context' list are applied only when those words appear near THE OCCURRENCE (disambiguation, evaluated occurrence-wise). Multi-word entries precede single words; overlapping matches are rejected in favour of the longest.
_meta.policy: No invented Yoruba. Ambiguous single words require context. Corrections go through human review before entry.

schema.translation: target-language rendering (must be attested, never generated)
schema.context: optional list of words; ALL must appear within +/-6 tokens of the candidate occurrence for the entry to fire
schema.status: 'verified' = attested and reviewed, applied by the glossary; 'assumed' = plausible but unreviewed, loaded for human review and NEVER substituted
schema.allow_unaccented: optional bool (default false); permits accent-folded matching. Automatically disabled when the folded form collides with a different term (e.g. igba), preventing silent meaning merges. Tone marks and underdots in input are otherwise matched exactly and always preserved in output.
